title: U.S. NOAA Weather Radio frequencies
overview: The seven frequencies are outside the regular AM and FM broadcast dial.
points: Receiver channel numbers can vary. Match the actual frequency in your manual.
SAME-capable alert receivers can filter by configured area. Test in standby.

title: FRS and GMRS handhelds
overview: Two U.S. voice radio services that share some channels.
points: Certified FRS handhelds are licensed by rule in the U.S. GMRS generally requires an individual FCC license.
Tone codes control what opens your speaker. Anyone on the channel can still hear the conversation.

title: AM detector and high-impedance audio
overview: A loop and capacitor tune the signal, then the diode recovers the audio envelope.
points: With a fixed coil, increasing capacitance lowers the tuned frequency.
A low-impedance speaker or standard headset can load down a passive detector. Use the kit-approved high-impedance transducer.

title: Receiver power and runtime
overview: Use measured listening time to plan a backup power reserve.
points: Power in watts is volts × amps. A 5 V receiver drawing 0.2 A uses approximately 1 W.
Energy in watt-hours is watts × hours. Real runtime depends on usable energy, conversion loss, volume and battery condition.

title: International Morse timing
overview: Count signal length and silence using the same base unit.
points: Dot: 1 unit. Dash: 3 units. Within-character gap: 1 unit.
Between characters: 3 units. Between words: 7 units. The continuous SOS prosign uses one-unit internal gaps.

title: Meshtastic and LoRa basics
overview: Compatible LoRa radios can exchange local messages without internet.
points: Choose the correct device region and matching channel configuration before testing.
Rehearse delivery with a second device. Terrain, antenna position and routing affect delivery.

title: Field message checklist
overview: Use a consistent format for a spoken check-in or handwritten radio log.
points: Record timestamp and time zone, who sent the message, location, situation and requested action.
Repeat back coordinates and other critical details. Log whether the message was acknowledged.
